text:
elaine: Quick sync notes from the FlowForge chat earlier — they want to plug their orchestration layer into our gateway and ship a joint reference flow. Wanted to capture action items here.
vikram: high level, which integration pattern are we aligning on? adapter vs native route?
elaine: they prefer an adapter that talks to our route API and can fallback to their hosted runner. keeps things decoupled for now.
kevin: timeline question — marketing asked for a co-announcement window. Do we have a target quarter?
maria: we should aim for a soft launch in their marketplace + a joint blog in ~6 weeks if engineering can deliver basic end-to-end.
vikram: tech notes — need a stable webhook for status, a short-lived token flow, and a config spec. Drafted a sample mapping: 
```
routes:
  - name: flowforge-default
    matcher: "/ff/*"
    adapter: flowforge-adapter:v1
    config:
      upstream: https://flowforge-hosted.example/api/v1/invoke
      auth: short_lived_token
```
kevin: @maria can you confirm legal/partner comms checklist? we need logo usage, joint PR signoff, and any required compliance callouts.
maria: on it. also will request a joint customer quote slot in the blog.
partner-bot: FlowForge onboarding form submitted: https://partners.example.com/flows/FF-314 — contact: anthony@flowforge.io — status: partner-accepted.
elaine: integration test plan: 1) adapter handshake (token + schema), 2) cold-start perf check with 256 token request, 3) end-to-end failure fallback (our degrade to compatible model). Can someone own tests?
vikram: I can pick up 1+2. will open a draft PR against https://git.redwood/partners/flowforge-integ.
kevin: I'll coordinate the launch calendar with GTM. can we agree on a feature flag to gate public docs? feature flag name: `ff_integration_enabled`
maria: agreed. also need marketplace listing assets: 1p and 3p logos, short description, and pricing notes. I'll collate.
elaine: items & owners: vikram -> PR + perf checks, kevin -> comms/announce calendar, maria -> marketplace assets & legal, elaine -> integration spec + e2e.
vikram: question on obs — do we add per-route latency dashboards in Console or just rely on FlowForge telemetry?
elaine: both. we need our route-level SLI in Console so customers see consistent numbers. FlowForge telemetry is optional for deep-dive.
kevin: marketing asked for a 1-pager by EOD Tue. that's aggressive but doable if we freeze the scope today.
maria: i'll draft the 1-pager using the spec elaine posted.
partner-bot: Reminder: partnership NDA requires co-approval for public announcing. Please add approvals in the partner workspace.
elaine: noted. next check-in Friday 10am PT. small sync only — blockers and PR review.
kevin: thanks all. :thumbsup:
vikram: pushing initial PR by EOD tomorrow, will include test harness and a sandbox route you can hit.
maria: sending marketplace asset request to FlowForge now.
elaine: closing thread for now — update here with PR link and any blocker flags.
